summary.headline: Advanced Enzyme Q4 FY26 revenue rose 22% YoY to INR 2,034 million, a record quarter, with EBITDA margin steady at 31%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue reached INR 2,034 million (+22% YoY, +18% QoQ) and FY26 revenue reached INR 7,458 million (+17%), both record levels per management. EBITDA rose 39% YoY to INR 632 million at a 31% margin, and PAT rose 69% YoY to INR 453 million (22% margin). Human Healthcare, Animal Healthcare, Bioprocessing and Specialized Manufacturing all grew on a YoY basis, with Serratiopeptidase volumes a key driver. Management flagged input cost inflation (fuel, salt, solvents, packaging, logistics) and a challenging US market, and guided to steady margins and a double-digit growth aspiration for FY27 without quantified guidance.

segments.name: Human Healthcare
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 1,281 million (+24% YoY, +33% QoQ); FY26 +15%. Contributes 63% of revenue; growth from pharma API, biocatalysis and nutrition volumes.

segments.name: Animal Healthcare
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 250 million (+19% YoY, +2% QoQ); FY26 +25%. Contributes 13% of revenue, driven by Asia.

segments.name: Bioprocessing
segments.commentary: Q4 +17% YoY but -10% QoQ; FY26 +16%. Food business +20% YoY in Q4 and +19% FY26; non-food -1% YoY and -7% QoQ, flat FY26.

segments.name: Specialized Manufacturing
segments.commentary: Q4 +17% YoY and +16% QoQ; FY26 +23%. Represents 9% of revenue.

segments.name: JC Biotech (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 172 million, EBITDA INR 15 million, PAT INR 3 million; FY26 revenue INR 728 million (vs INR 600 million), EBITDA INR 92 million, PBT INR 29 million.

segments.name: Evoxx (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 88 million, EBITDA INR 19 million, PAT INR 14 million; FY26 revenue INR 319 million (+50%), EBITDA INR 72 million, PAT INR 50 million.

segments.name: Scitech (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 179 million, EBITDA INR 38 million, PAT INR 29 million; FY26 revenue INR 668 million (+23%), EBITDA INR 104 million (+37%), PAT INR 45 million (+22%).

guidance_outlook: Management expects steady margins in FY27 and says the momentum will continue; no numeric revenue or margin guidance was given.
Aspiration of double-digit growth in FY27, with expected 'little growth' from US (not negative) and healthy growth from India across human nutraceutical, food and animal feed.
Margin impact from US cost pressures could be 1-2%, per management, but the base assumption is unchanged margins.
Price increases to offset cost inflation are planned to start from the new year (FY27), per management.
R&D spend expected to rise by about INR 50 million in absolute terms; R&D capex about INR 50 crore this year (total about INR 130 crore, per call).
Biocatalysis expected to show some growth in FY27, described as moderate; Nashik R&D centre expected operational in H2 FY27, targeting threefold capacity in first phase.
Anti-inflammatory enzyme EU novel food approval expected this year; management says it could give exclusivity for 5-10 years but no numbers given.
capex_capacity: Fermentation capacity of about 500 cubic metres; infrastructure in place to add 50% capacity immediately, with a decision on expansion at a subsidiary after September 2026.
Main-company capacity expansion decision to be taken after September; capacity increment at a subsidiary possible this year.
Nashik R&D centre to become fully operational in the latter half of FY27; management said this is among the largest research centres it knows of.
R&D capex planned at about INR 50 crore in FY27 within a total of about INR 130 crore cited on the call.
demand_pricing: Pricing for the Indian Serratiopeptidase business described as broadly constant; growth was volume-driven, with price increases planned to pass on costs from the new year.
Gross margin moderated QoQ; management attributed this to product mix (higher domestic share) and cost inflation, offset by productivity gains and operating leverage.

US business: market shifting toward registration and studies; revenue down about 11% YoY in INR in Q4 per analyst's calculation. Management says growth will be modest, with US demand under pressure from discretionary spending.
Tariffs: company absorbing about 10% of tariff cost for now and passing on gradually; no full pass-through.
Serratiopeptidase: YTD growth about 45% and QoQ about 54%, shared for the last time, per management.
Top product (anti-inflammatory enzyme) 23% of FY26 revenue; top 10 customers 23% of revenue vs 22% in FY25.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin moderate QoQ despite EBITDA margin expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited variable vs fixed cost mix and productivity gains on some products, with inflation partly offsetting; no quantified gross margin figure was given on the call.

qa_highlights.question: Is there price increase in Indian Serratiopeptidase or only volume growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Pricing is more or less constant and growth is volume-driven; cost pass-through is planned from the new year.

qa_highlights.question: What is happening with US revenue, and should strategy change?
qa_highlights.answer: Market is shifting to registration and studies; strategy is changing accordingly. Management expects US growth in FY27, though 'very challenging'.

qa_highlights.question: Biocatalysis revenue for Q4 and FY26?
qa_highlights.answer: Management gave FY26 biocatalysis revenue of INR 247 million vs INR 174 million in FY25; no Q4 figure was given.

qa_highlights.question: Capital allocation and buyback given INR 700 crore cash and no interim dividend?
qa_highlights.answer: Chairman said the board will evaluate options, including buyback, and decide at the right time; no decision announced.

qa_highlights.question: Why has operating leverage not lifted gross margin from the 75% level seen post-COVID?
qa_highlights.answer: Management chose customer traction over margin for now, and expects margins to stay around current levels.

risks_watch: Input cost inflation (fuel, salt, solvents, packaging, logistics) with limited ability to pass through quickly; management says near-term margin pressure is likely.
US business softness: discretionary spending pressure, tariffs, and a shift in market structure; Q4 US revenue down about 11% YoY in INR per analyst.
Senior management change: Deepak Roda left; his Indian and US responsibilities split between two heads.
Competition in Serratiopeptidase and the decision to stop disclosing product-level growth may limit visibility.
Biocatalysis trials face regulatory and competitive challenges; timing of revenue uncertain.
Patent count reduced from 17 to 15 in investor presentation as non-revenue patents were dropped.
Probiotics revenue reported lower YoY because sales are now bundled into formulations; the company does not separate them.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the FY26 numbers and long-term positioning, but cautious and somewhat evasive on US outlook, cost pass-through and product-level detail. Management repeatedly described FY27 as 'very challenging' while guiding to steady margins.
key_quotes: This is going to be a very challenging year no matter what, okay.
Quality of revenue is extremely well and very stable.
So, we expect little growth coming from the U.S., and not like the negative growth.
In terms of pricing, the pricing is more or less constant. It's more driven by the volume.

growth.why: Management aspires to double-digit FY27 growth (no numeric guidance) with steady margins, US flat-to-little growth, and price increases from FY27; backing is vague beyond a 50% subsidiary fermentation increment (decision after Sept 2026) and the Nashik R&D centre due in H2 FY27.
